demo.code:
You: Is the NVDA price usable right now?
Agent: (reads the verdict from the WeekendMark oracle on Base: market closed for the weekend, last print and its age, not an outage)
You: What does my vault refuse to do while it is closed?
Agent: (reads rebalanceStatus() and explains each refusal reason in plain language)

setup: Ask: Is the NVDA price usable right now?
Read oracle verdicts and vault state by conversation; owner actions go through the Own Index web app
